title: MOTION (JURADO - NAZARIAN) relative to authorizing the Department of Neighborhood Empowerment (DONE) to host the annual Neighborhood Council Budget Day in…
text:
[Council File 26-1598]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (JURADO - NAZARIAN) relative to authorizing the Department of Neighborhood Empowerment (DONE) to host the annual Neighborhood Council Budget Day in City Hall at various spaces within City Hall on June 26, 2027.
Recommendation for Council action:
AUTHORIZE DONE to use the City Hall Rotunda, City Hall Forecourt, John Ferraro Council Chamber, Room 350, Room 401 and 10th Floor of City Hall on Saturday, June 26, 2027, from 6:00 am to 2:00pm, with the understanding that all costs incurred by the General Services Department associated with this event will be reimbursed to that Department by the Department of Neighborhood Empowerment.
